description: The linked reader's taste: the books, authors, series, genres and moods they love, what they avoid or quit, and why each counts, in their own words where they gave them. Suits "what kind of books do I like" and "would I like X". Returns the strongest 40 entries; limit raises that. Needs a linked Siftivo account.
